name: Deuteronomy
title: Deuteronomy — Covenant Renewal
tagline: Love the LORD your God with all your heart.

author.traditional: Traditional: Moses (final chapters on his death by prophetic hand).

date.range_display: Plains of Moab, end of Moses’ life.

audience: Second generation about to enter Canaan.
purpose: Rehearse the law and bind hearts to exclusive loyalty.
christ: Prophet like Moses (18 → Acts 3); the One who keeps the law we broke.
jesus_in_this_book: Prophet like Moses (18 → Acts 3); the One who keeps the law we broke.
how_to_read: Sermon, not statute book only. Hear Moses plead.
watchman_charge: Teach the next watch the Shema. Loyalty is not optional.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
